title: Annotatio III §.V open: Last and most perfect Reformation-century Concord attempt — SENDOMIRIENSE in Poland, 1570 (Consensus Sendomiriensis)
pass_a_gloss: §. V. The last Consociation attempt of Protestant Concord of the first Reformation century, not indeed in Germany, but undertaken in Poland in the year 1570, is the most perfect of all, the SENDOMIR one, celebrated under the surname of the Sendomir Consensus.
pass_b_english: §. V. The last Consociation attempt at Protestant Concord in that first Reformation century was not in Germany but in Poland in 1570.
It is the most perfect of all — the Sendomir attempt, celebrated under the name Consensus Sendomiriensis.
source_text:
§. V.
Postremum Seculi ejusdem Reformationis primi molimen Concordiae Protestanticae, non in Germania quidem, sed in Polonia An. 1570. susceptum omnium perfectissimum SENDOMIRIENSE est, Consensus Sendomiriensis cognomine celebratum.
notes: Hexades Annotatio III §.V open: SENDOMIRIENSE / Consensus Sendomiriensis Poland 1570.
